patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports experiencing fever, chills, and a headache starting three days after undergoing an open cholecystectomy. She has a history of an abdominal hysterectomy 16 years ago. She has been smoking one pack of cigarettes daily for 17 years.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Right-sided chest pain that increases on inspiration
Secondary_Symptoms: Productive cough for the last 12 hours

Social_History.Smoking_Status: Current smoker, one pack daily for 17 years

Review_of_Systems.Gastrointestinal: Surgical site below right ribcage, otherwise unremarkable

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate the patient presenting with postoperative fever, chest pain that increases on inspiration, and a productive cough, and determine the correct diagnosis.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I had an open gallbladder surgery about three days ago, and since then I’ve had fever and chills with a headache. Now I also have right-sided chest pain that gets worse when I take a deep breath, and I’ve had a productive cough for the last 12 hours.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints at all.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a persistent urge to scratch anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any itching or any persistent urge to scratch anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t have any trouble lifting my arms above my head.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’ve had a fever with chills, but I don’t know if it’s been above 104 °F; I’ve felt pretty uncomfortable and shaky, but not dizzy.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t been unusually stressed or overwhelmed—I’ve mainly just been feeling sick since the surgery: fever and chills with a headache, plus this right-sided chest pain worse with deep breaths and a productive cough.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, yes—I’ve been having chills along with the fever since the surgery, and it’s been making me feel very shaky and uncomfortable.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breasts that feel fixed or don’t move?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breasts, and nothing feels fixed or doesn’t move.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling any pain or discomfort on the side of your back or abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, the discomfort is mostly on the right side of my chest and gets worse when I take a deep breath; I don’t really notice pain on my back or between my ribs and hips beyond where the surgical area is.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does it go away when you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any calf pain when I walk, and I haven’t had to stop because of leg pain.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your urine looks darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed that my urine looks darker than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any difficulty moving your arm up or across your body?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any difficulty moving my arm up or across my body—I can lift my arms normally.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your joints feel sore or stiff after doing the same activity repeatedly, like after a long day of typing, lifting, or other repetitive motions?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any joint soreness or stiffness after doing repetitive activities—my main issues have been fever and chills with a headache since the surgery, and now the right-sided chest pain that worsens with deep breaths along with a productive cough.”
